references.text: The parallel account in Exodus where the Lord tells Moses that the people have acted corruptly and made a cast calf, and have bowed down to it.
The background for the golden calf that the people made while Moses was on the mountain.
The Lord commands Moses to come down from the mountain, the same command given here.
Moses' prophetic warning that the people will act corruptly and turn away from the way the Lord has commanded.
A warning against making any cast image or idol, which the people broke by making the golden calf.
The second commandment forbidding carved images, which the people broke by making the cast image.
Judges describes how Israel left the path their fathers had walked, similar to the apostasy described here.
Stephen's speech in Acts refers to this apostasy when the people made the calf and sacrificed to the idol.
